requirements.proposed_case_name: no successful sacrifice produces no payoff

requirements.proposed_case_name: source leaving does not erase its pending trigger
requirements.normal: Remove Disciple before trigger resolution; other-creature sacrifice and exact payoff still work.

requirements.proposed_case_name: paused choice and game state serialize without changing the payoff
